added: When you connect Device Sync, a Server field shows which sync server you're using. It's pre-filled with the Caller's Compendium server, and you can change it if you run your own. The app warns you before you use a different server and keeps showing it on the sync status.
fixed: Connecting Device Sync no longer fails with "Device Sync isn't available right now" on builds that were never given a sync server address.

added: Classify the `sync_endpoint` setting as device-scoped, so it never syncs or travels in a backup.
